why: A held pip loses the inset fill (issue #1022's review). Its border is half its size, and Chromium floors a border width to whole pixels (measured at DPR 1, 2 and 3), so the 9px rung -- four teams players at three stocks on a phone, the strip #1022 made the default -- draws a 4px border round a 1px hole and every held pip reads as a thick ring rather than a dot. Measured in Chromium before the fix: the centre pixel of a held 9px pip was the page behind it. jsdom lays nothing out, so only the stylesheet test that reads the fill the cascade gives a held pip, against a lost one, can see it.
